title: echo-out
system_instruction_addendum: ECHO-OUT ADDENDUM: The echo-out is a bail. Hit echo on deck a, kill its channel, deck b takes over. Frame it as a safety net, not a featured move.

tutor_speak.text: the echo-out is your bail. hit echo on deck a, pull the channel down, and deck b owns the room.
tap the echo button on deck a: the tail decays while deck b plays clean.

hints.text: the echo lives in the effects strip: on the flx4 it shares the pad row.
tap it once to arm: the deck's tail starts repeating.
press the echo button on deck a.
